rail-width.$description: Main rail (MainNav) expanded width (mainNavRules "Two widths"). No Spacing-ramp step is close enough to snap to (ramp: 4, 6, 8, 12, 16, 18, 22, 32, 44) — a component-specific exception, the same category as --icon-callout and --text-callout-title. Proposed as-is pending the token decisions ticket, flagged in the PR (LDS-035).

rail-width-collapsed.$description: Main rail (MainNav) collapsed width — already cited as a true fact of the system by Scrollbar's own shipped entry ("its own 56px collapsed rail", packages/content/src/entries/components/scrollbar.ts) and by Navigation (Main)'s own draft stub before this ticket. No Spacing-ramp step matches; kept at this exact value rather than snapped, so it stays consistent with those two already-shipped references. Flagged in the PR (LDS-035).

subnav-width.$description: Subnav rail (Navigation (Subnav)) column width (subnavAnatomy #1). No Spacing-ramp step is close enough to snap to. Flagged in the PR (LDS-035).

header-height.$description: Header bar height (headerRules "Fixed 52px") — also the main rail's own brand-lockup row height, so the header's top edge and the rail's first hairline land flush. No Spacing-ramp step is close enough to snap to. Flagged in the PR (LDS-035).

min-width.$description: Narrowest width the shell lays out at; below it the page scrolls horizontally rather than compressing the main navigation (the phone tab bar's four labels stop fitting around here). 320px is WCAG 1.4.10 Reflow's own reference width. No Spacing-ramp step applies — a layout floor, not a spacing value. Proposed as-is pending the token decisions ticket, flagged in the PR (LDS-155).
